title: Missed reading alert does not trigger for xDrip Sync follower

comments.body:
@jamorham @tzachi-dar 
I set up a test phone as an xDrip Sync follower running the latest Nightly release.
I enabled Missed Reading alert and set it to trigger after 6 minutes of no readings.
After a while having 6 or 7 readings, I disabled WiFi with no sim card in the phone.  
No missed reading alert is triggered.

Performing the exact same test as a Nightscout follower results in a missed reading alert.

So, I thought we must have made a change causing this while we made the major change to xDrip Sync in July 2024.
I installed an older version of xDrip, 2024.07.17, before that change on the follower.
I disabled "Use xDrip Cloud" on the master.  I got readings in the follower.  Waited for 5 readings.  Then, disabled WiFi again.  I was surprised that there still was no missed reading alert.  

This tells me that we have never had a working missed reading alert for xDrip Sync.  But, why has no one reported this for years until now?  

I see that the missed reading alert is not active unless there is a local sensor.  I see that there is a line in the code that creates a local sensor for a Nightscout follower if one does not exist.  But, there isn't one for xDrip Sync.
I am going to experiment with removing the requirement for a local sensor for xDrip Sync follower and if my tests succeed, open a PR.

Fwiw, this definitely used to work in the past. We are running in this settings for many years and we used to get the alerts every now and then. I am not sure how long ago that stopped working though. Could have been quite a few months.
This should be fixed now as of this release: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2025.06.17
